Dear ioet recruiting team,

I am applying for the Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer position. I am a Staff Software Engineer based in Brazil with 14 years of experience developing production-grade Rails platforms. For the past three years, my work has focused precisely on the intersection required by this role: a Rails application, LLM-based features deployed to production, and a React frontend connecting the two. Since 2020, I have worked as an engineer embedded in remote US teams, communicating daily in English.

Most recently, I served as a Staff Software Engineer at Effortless Ads (a Google Cloud-hosted Google Ads automation platform managing over 1,000 active campaigns). The project most relevant to this role was a data scraper that fueled the application's campaign creation process. This involved a data collection system that utilized LLMs to gather data generically from previously unknown websites (going beyond simple chat functionality). Key components included link discovery combining string proximity scoring with the OpenAI API; multi-page processing (parsing) involving meta tags, JSON-LD, and regex; semantic HTML segmentation with segment classification via the OpenAI API prior to data parsing; and normalization to reconcile between one and six conflicting data sources per property. I used embeddings (text-embedding-3) for text classification and comparison in this instance. I initially developed a solution using hierarchical clustering based on text-embedding-3 classifications and cosine similarity, but I ultimately simplified the approach by using OpenAI’s lower-complexity, lower-cost models (*-mini models). The system achieved approximately 98% success using the primary source, with a ~2% fallback rate via Google Search to secondary listing sites in the event of primary source failure, executing thousands of tasks daily on Cloud Functions and Cloud Run.

I have also worked with Rails and React on large-scale production systems and on complex debugging. At Drip (serving ~6,000 clients and handling 100–150 million email/SMS events per month), I identified the root cause of a persistent failure that intermittently dropped millions of marketing messages: thread-safety issues in the Shopify gem, which stored credentials in module-level variables when running on Sidekiq. I proposed and executed a migration to Resque’s forking execution model; I also led the integration with Yotpo, processing millions of events monthly. At Shift Technologies (NASDAQ: SFT), I worked as a full-stack product engineer for a used car marketplace. Previously, as CTO of BDS Turismo, I designed the architecture for a B2B travel marketplace that processed around 120 bookings per day and 500,000 flight searches per month, including a real-time pricing engine (scraper), inventory and reconciliation systems, ERP integration via SOAP, and multiple payment gateways, while leading a team of two to three junior developers and handling code reviews, architecture, and mentoring. Across these experiences, I worked with: REST and SOAP APIs, webhooks, Google Ads and Google Analytics APIs, Stripe, PostgreSQL and MySQL, Redis, Datadog and Sentry, RSpec and TDD, and CI/CD.

What attracts me to this role is the approach to AI capabilities as an engineering task within a real-world product. Throughout my career, I have always enjoyed tackling complex problems, and perhaps that is why companies have frequently asked me to build scrapers, for instance.

I am based in Brazil and available immediately with complete time-zone flexibility. My salary expectations are flexible, as I am primarily seeking career opportunities and long-term partnerships where I can grow and take on greater responsibilities within the company.

Sincerely,

Fabiano Ishiy Zaparoli
